cases.question: What did Nitin work on at BNY?
cases.answer: Nitin worked as a Java Software Engineer at BNY from August 2024 to September 2024, a remote contract role [experience-bny#1]. He enhanced Java and Spring Boot services for data-ingestion, validation and processing workflows on the Bridgewater platform [experience-bny#2]. He also implemented REST APIs for internal-system integration, built relational data-access components using JDBC and Spring Data, optimized queries, and resolved defects within Agile sprints [experience-bny#3].

cases.question: What frontend technologies does Nitin know?
cases.answer: Nitin's frontend skills include React, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3 and JSP, and he has worked on integrating frontend code with REST APIs and microservices [skills#4]. At Copart, as a Java Full Stack Engineer, he developed reusable React single-page application components using JavaScript, HTML5 and CSS3, and connected them to backend REST APIs for auction and inventory workflows [experience-copart#3].

cases.question: Has Nitin worked with Kubernetes in production?
cases.answer: The background materials don't mention Kubernetes, so I can't confirm any production Kubernetes work. They do show container work: Nitin containerized applications with Docker and deployed services on AWS at Copart [experience-copart#4], and he deployed Dockerized microservices on AWS at JPMorgan Chase [experience-jpmc-2024#4]. His skills list includes AWS ECS and Docker [skills#2]. For a direct answer on Kubernetes, please contact Nitin through the Contact section of this page.
